Banski Suhodol summit
trails.why: Banski Suhodol is a peak in the Pirin mountain, south-western Bulgaria. It is located in the northern part of Pirin on the main ridge.

trails.name: Deno summit
trails.why: Deno is a peak in the eastern part of the Rila Mountain in southwestern Bulgaria. It is 2,790 m high and is the fourth highest summit in the mountain range behind Musala, Malka Musala and Irechek.

trails.name: Газей summit
trails.why: Gazey is a peak in the Pirin mountain, Bulgaria situated on a small sideward ridge of the Polejansli Ridge.

trails.name: Ibar summit
trails.why: The summit is conical, north-eastern, with sharp ridges over the circus terrace, where the Iberian Lake is located. It flows into the Eyreander River, as the summit...

trails.why: The summit of the Rila mountain range, in Bulgaria, at an altitude of 2669 m above sea level.

trails.name: Славов връх summit
trails.why: The famous peak is located in East Rila at an altitude of 2,306 m.

trails.name: Жълтец summit
trails.why: Yellowstone is a peak in the Calofer Mountains, part of the Middle Old Mountain, 2226.8 meters high.

trails.name: Golyam Kupen summit
trails.why: The Great Kupen is a steep rocky peak in the Calofer Mountains, Central Old Mountain, with a typical Alpine profile.

trails.name: Tetevenska baba summit
trails.why: Baba is a peak in the Zlatko-Tetevenka mountain, part of the Middle Old Mountain, Bulgaria, it is 2,071 meters high.

trails.name: Selimitsa summit
trails.why: Selimitsa is a peak rising to 2,041 m west of Torfeno Branishte Nature Reserve in northwestern Vitosha Mountain in Bulgaria.

trails.name: Kostenurkata summit
trails.why: The turtle is the highest peak in the Kaloper Mountains, central to the Old Mountain.

trails.name: Golyam Krŭstets summit

trails.name: Ribarishki prokhod pass
trails.why: The Fisherman's Pass is a mountain pass in the western part of the Middle Old Mountain, between the Zlatiško-Tetevenska Mountain in the west and the Trojan Mountain in the east in the Municipality of Teteven, Lovech Oblast and the Municipality of Karlovy Vary, Plovdiv Oblast.

trails.name: Злия зъб summit
trails.why: Zlia Zab is a summit in the northwestern part of the Rila mountain range in southwestern Bulgaria reaching height of 2,678 m.

trails.name: Йозола lake
trails.why: Yosola is a circular lake in the central part of Rila, in the basin of the river Levy Isker. It is located at 2139 m asl and has an elongated shape from north to south with a length of 340 m and width of 175 m, its area is 6.81 ha, and its maximum depth is 7 m.

trails.name: Dry lake
trails.why: Dry Lake is a lake in the central part of Rila, at 1891.5 m AD, in the catchment basin of Rila River, 1500 m southeast of Peak Popova Cap. It is located in the province of Kustendil, municipality of Rila.
